alternate_names: Sri Sri Radha Krishna Baldev Ji Mandir

history.summary: ISKCON (Hare Krishna) temple at Deorhi, Shubhankarpur, Darbhanga, dedicated to Sri Sri Radha Krishna and Baldev Ji (Balaram). It follows standard ISKCON daily worship with Mangala arati and evening arati; the centre's own website is iskcondarbhanga.com. NOTE: the founding/consecration year is not published in any source found - flag. Coordinates are a POI-level match corroborated by the temple's own site (26.16144, 85.887547). No reliable on-topic photograph was found after genuine image searching, so media is left empty.

name: ISKCON Temple, Darbhanga
town_description: Darbhanga is a major city in north Bihar's Mithila region and the former seat of the Darbhanga Raj, whose palaces, forts, temples and ponds (such as Harahi and Dighi) dot the city. It hosts Lalit Narain Mithila University and Kameshwar Singh Darbhanga Sanskrit University, and its many Kali and Durga temples - including the famous Shyama Mai temple - make it a noted centre of Shakti worship.

travel.road: Shubhankarpur (Deorhi), Darbhanga city; reachable by local auto and bus
